title: Effects of Kinesio-taping in Knee Osteoarthritis Patients.
brief_summary: The main reason to conduct this research is to find the comparison of kinseotaping according to time duration that is 24 hours, 48 hours and 72 hours in knee osteoarthritis patients. We can find the impact of kinseo-taping on pain, balance and functional status of patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with unilateral and bilateral knee OA
* O.A with grade 2-3(Kellgren and Lawrence system for classification of osteoarthritis of knee)
* Experiencing Pain for more than 1 month

Exclusion Criteria:

* Rheumatic diseases, inflammatory arthritis, septic arthritis
* Intra-articular corticosteroid injection during the past month
* Patients with fracture
* Patients with any carcinoma
* if patient having any other systemic illness.
* Allergic reaction to KT
